summary: Added public schema_registry::write_registry<W: Write + ?Sized>(&mut W, &str) -> Result<(), serde_json::Error>. Existing APIs and registry metadata remain unchanged. Added five integration tests covering exact compact output and escaped/Unicode versions, mutable trait-object writers and continued use, short writes without flushing, immediate and partial-output failures, and WriteZero. All 15 existing unit tests and five new integration tests passed; build, Clippy, and the final formatting check passed.
